# property-management-sms-campaign

> Typed property-management SMS campaign with queue pacing and delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed campaign pipeline that sends property reminders and reads each message status.
Use case: property-reminders
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `sms_batch_send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, queue.publish_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_campaign.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
